title: COMP-MODEL-AB-DECISION registry contract: row shape, admission, compatKey, uplift, latest, catalog rule, promotion/demotion, measurementDecision
_source: docs/features/COMP-MODEL-AB-DECISION/plan.md ### G1 (COMP-STAGE-GRADING-1) and ### Hub contracts; run records from stage-run-contract.json
_changelog: 2026-10-20 G1 (COMP-STAGE-GRADING-1): first version. registry.json, row, admission predicate, compatKey rule, uplift, promotion evidence, promoteRows/demoteRows arguments, measurementDecision file (review r2 R2-3).

2026-10-20 G1 fix round 1 (COMP-STAGE-GRADING-1): $.semantic[] names the predicates JSON Schema cannot check (joins and arithmetic) with reject codes and a conformance suite ($.semanticCases[]); prior rows get their own shape (as_of, n); empty-sample statistics are null and attemptedRunIds is added beside sourceRunIds; #measurementDecision and #promotion resolve; effort is the catalog enum; worked identities follow the resolver.
description: Validate by pointing at one of $defs (examples[].validatesAgainst). Cross-record rules a schema cannot express are in `rules`.

rules.admission: A run is admitted iff outcome.completed === true, no _error, not skipped, metrics.stage.oracleError === null, accuracy numeric, canaryOk === true and mechanismEngaged === true. Machine form: $defs.admittedRun. nAttempted counts every non-skipped run of the cell (attemptedRunIds), nAdmitted counts the admitted ones (sourceRunIds).
rules.measured: A row is `measured` iff its stage is objective (not design/plan, or it carries a non-null promotion) AND nAdmitted >= 3 AND nAdmitted * 3 >= nAttempted * 2; otherwise `triaged` with a triageReason. The SCHEMA enforces only: measured has triageReason null and nAdmitted >= 3, triaged has a triageReason string, and the judged-stage promotion coupling. The ratio, the iff itself and nAdmitted <= nAttempted are semantic predicates S1 and S2.
rules.judgedStages: Rows of the judged stages (design, plan) are written `triaged` with `JUDGED_UNPROMOTED` until promoted; a `measured` judged row must carry a non-null promotion.
rules.compatKey: sha256 hex of the canonical JSON (keys sorted at every depth, no whitespace) of {stage, archetypeVersion, fixtureDigest, oracleVersion}. Uplift is computed only within one compatKey and the champion must be `measured` in it, else uplift null with upliftNullReason NO_COMPATIBLE_CHAMPION. A newer compatKey never mixes with an older one.
rules.cellKey: stage plus the resolved ingredients (provider, modelID, effort, workflow), joined with `|`, for example `debug|claude|claude-sonnet-5-5|standard|default`. Never a tier name alone.
rules.latest: latest[stage][compatKey][cellKey] = rowId of the newest `measured` row of that cell (newest by generatedAt). A `prior` row is never in latest. Enforced by semantic predicates S5 and S6, not by the schema.
rules.prior: A `prior` row (fleet prior, P1) has its own closed shape, $defs.priorRow: rowId, stage, cellKey, ingredients (effort and workflow may be null = unknown), state "prior", vector (only accuracy is meaningful, a {median, min, max} of the first-pass CLEAN fraction; the other five are null), as_of and n exactly as P1 keeps them, generatedAt. ABSENT on a prior because there is no experiment behind it: compatKey, catalogDigest, fixtureId, fixtureDigest, archetypeVersion, oracleVersion, nAttempted, nAdmitted, triageReason, uplift, upliftNullReason, promotion, sourceRunIds, attemptedRunIds, experimentId. A prior row's cellKey writes `unknown` for a null effort or workflow. A prior may never be uplift input, a champion, in `latest`, or selectable by assembly (S4, S5).
rules.catalogRule: Assembly uses only rows whose catalogDigest equals the target digest, where the target is the explicit digest when one is named (--catalog-digest), else the current catalog's digest. A selected row that does not equal the target is refused with STALE_CATALOG. Enforced by semantic predicate S7, not by the schema.
rules.measurementDecisionOwnership: Written by M1; read by A1 and V1.
rules.validationBoundary: JSON Schema (Ajv 2020) checks SHAPE only. The rules in $.semantic[] need arithmetic or joins across rows, which JSON Schema cannot express, so they are NOT enforced by validating against $defs.registry. They are enforced by one function, validateRegistrySemantics(registry, {currentCatalogDigest, explicitCatalogDigest, selectedRowIds}) -> [{code, rowId}], which G4's registry writer (lib/experiment-registry.js) calls before every write of registry.json, A1 calls before it selects rows, and P1 calls over the prior rows it adds. An empty result is the only pass. $.semanticCases[] is its conformance suite (each case is a registry that is schema-valid, so only this layer can reject it).
rules.demoted: demoteRows(registry, {rowIds, reason: "JUDGE_DRIFT"}) sets state `triaged`, triageReason `JUDGE_DRIFT` and KEEPS the row's promotion object as the record of what was demoted (a judged triaged row with a null promotion must say JUDGED_UNPROMOTED, so a demoted row cannot have it null).
rules.emptySample: Statistics over an empty admitted set are null, never zeros: when nAdmitted is 0 every vector member is null (schema); when nAdmitted > 0 every member except usd is a {median, min, max} (schema). sourceRunIds lists the ADMITTED runs the vector was computed over; attemptedRunIds lists every non-skipped run of the cell (admitted or not). Both counts are checked by S3.

admittedRun.description: Partial schema of a stage run record (stage-run-contract.json $defs.stageRunExecuted): matches iff the run is admitted. A run with canaryOk false, mechanismEngaged false, an oracleError, null accuracy, an _error, a skipped marker or an incomplete outcome does NOT match.

spread.description: {median, min, max} over the admitted runs (never over an empty set: see rules.emptySample).

spreadOrNull.description: null = no statistic: usd when any admitted run had unknown cost, and every member when nAdmitted is 0.

promotionEvidence.description: Evidence accepted by promoteRows(registry, {rowIds, evidence}); also the shape stored in row.promotion.

measurementDecision.description: #measurementDecision (review r2 R2-3): written by M1, read by A1 and V1. `measured` carries no reason; `noSignal` carries one.

effort.description: Allowed resolved efforts, from lib/model-catalog.js:11 (the catalog's own list). resolveAgentConfig returns null effort for a tier with no thinking config (for example claude::budget); record that as "unavailable". A tier label such as "standard" is never an effort.

priorIngredients.description: Fleet-prior ingredients: provider and modelID are known, effort and workflow are null when the fleet data does not say.

priorVector.description: Only accuracy (the first-pass CLEAN fraction as {median: f, min: f, max: f}) is meaningful for a prior; the other members are null, never fabricated.

asOf.description: The as_of stamp of estimate.py output, kept verbatim (for example 2026-10-17T20:48).

sourceRunIds.description: The ADMITTED runs the vector was computed over (length nAdmitted, may be empty).

attemptedRunIds.description: Every non-skipped run of the cell, admitted or not (length nAttempted).

experimentRow.description: A row written by an experiment (state triaged or measured). Prior rows are $defs.priorRow.

priorRow.description: state `prior`: a fleet prior (P1). See rules.prior for what is absent and why.

row.description: Any registry row: an experiment row (triaged | measured) or a prior row, discriminated by state.

promotion.description: #promotion: the entry point for promotion and demotion. Matches the evidence object (what J2 hands over and what row.promotion stores), the promoteRows(registry, {rowIds, evidence}) arguments, or the demoteRows(registry, {rowIds, reason}) arguments. The three shapes are disjoint. Consumers that need exactly one use #promotionEvidence, #promoteRowsArgs or #demoteRowsArgs.

semantic.statement: Let eligible = (stage is not design/plan OR promotion is non-null) AND nAdmitted >= 3 AND nAdmitted * 3 >= nAttempted * 2. Unless triageReason is INCOMPATIBLE or JUDGE_DRIFT (assigned by assembly and demoteRows): state === "measured" iff eligible, and a triaged row's triageReason is the first that applies of JUDGED_UNPROMOTED (judged stage, promotion null), LOW_N (nAdmitted < 3), LOW_ADMISSION (nAdmitted * 3 < nAttempted * 2).
attemptedRunIds.length === nAttempted, sourceRunIds.length === nAdmitted, sourceRunIds is a subset of attemptedRunIds, and neither list repeats an id.

A row with a non-null uplift names a champion: some row of the same registry has that cellKey, the SAME compatKey, and state `measured`. A prior or triaged row, or a row of another compatKey, is not a champion.
No rowId in latest and no selected rowId names a `prior` row.

Every latest[stage][compatKey][cellKey] = rowId names an existing row whose stage, compatKey and cellKey are those keys, whose state is `measured`, and which is the newest (generatedAt) measured row of that stage, compatKey and cellKey.

target = explicitCatalogDigest if non-null else currentCatalogDigest. Every selected row is `measured` and has catalogDigest === target, else STALE_CATALOG. Naming the digest the rows carry therefore overrides a newer current catalog; naming any other digest does not.

refProbes.description: $ref strings the plan and its consumers use; the oracle compiles each exactly. Each entry carries one instance that must match.
